_about: Which outside systems (connectors) the agents may use. connectors: false turns one off for every agent. agents: the exact list of connectors one agent has; an agent not listed keeps its defaults. The code sets the limit (api/toolkit CEILING): a connector the code forbids for an agent cannot be given here, and the workspace stops with an error if you try. GET /api/toolkit shows the result. Agents only read; sending email and writing to the CRM happen only after a person clicks.

limits._about: Calls per day for each connector, all agents and people together. null = no limit. People can change it in the workspace (PUT /api/toolkit/limits/{connector}).
